name: Gorm Mudmouth
place: dungeon drowned_vent (The Drowned Vent, Fumarole Fen, level 14): floor 1's mini-boss
_doc: A mudback lurker that lives in the warm silt. P1 "Lurking": bites and a tail sweep; it sinks into the mud and comes up under a player (a circle that follows them, then erupts), leaving sucking mud (stuck). P2 at 50% "Wallow": it rolls, throwing mud waves in a cross, and drags people in from across the room.
party: Solo: walk away from where it will surface. 2-3: keep the sucking mud at the room edges. 5: spread — it surfaces under someone every few seconds.

pull: The mud bulges, then breathes out.
Two eyes on stalks rise out of the silt.
say.death: Gorm sinks into the mud for the last time. A few bubbles, then nothing.
say.reset: Gorm sinks back into the silt.

enrage.say: Gorm thrashes the whole room into mud!

surface.name: Surface
surface.say: Gorm sinks — the mud moves under {target}!

mud_cross.name: Mud Waves
mud_cross.say: Mud waves roll out in four lines!

drag.name: Drag Under
drag.say: Gorm hauls {target} toward it through the mud!

phases.name: Wallow
phases.say: Gorm rolls in the mud, throwing it everywhere!
